issues.legal_issue: Land transferred under an agreement for sale without a valid document of title remains part of the transferor’s holding when the transferor retains ownership, even if the transferee is in possession.
material_facts: The declarant transferred portions of his land under unregistered sale deeds pursuant to an agreement for sale.
The transferee took possession under the agreement, but no valid deed of title was executed in the transferee’s favour.
The declarant retained ownership of the transferred land and excluded it from his declaration of his holding.
The Land Reforms Tribunal included the land in the declarant’s holding, while the High Court excluded it on the basis of the transferee’s possession.
issues.conclusion: The land transferred under the defective title deeds remained part of the transferor’s holding; the High Court erred in excluding it.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 3(i) of the Andhra Pradesh Land Reforms (Ceiling on Agricultural Holdings) Act, 1973, and its explanation, “held” encompasses ownership as well as possession, and land held in different capacities may be included in the holdings of different persons. Possession under an agreement for sale does not transfer title without a valid document of title, although the possessor may be entitled to remain in possession and recover it if dispossessed. The Court relied on no earlier cases.

rule.if: ceiling_proceeding and transferor_retained_ownership and transferee_possessed_land_under_sale_agreement and no_valid_title_document

predicates.ceiling_proceeding: The matter concerned determining a person’s land holding for the purpose of an agricultural land ceiling.
predicates.transferor_retained_ownership: The person who agreed to transfer the land continued to own it.
predicates.transferee_possessed_land_under_sale_agr: The proposed transferee took possession of the land pursuant to an agreement for sale.
predicates.no_valid_title_document: No valid document transferring title to the land was executed in favour of the transferee.

issues.definition: When a ceiling proceeding concerns land still owned by a transferor but possessed by a proposed transferee under a sale agreement without a valid title document, the land remains part of the transferor’s holding.

issues.legal_issue: The possibility that the same land will be included in the holdings of people holding it in different capacities does not justify construing the definition of holding to exclude it from an owner’s holding.
material_facts: The owner agreed to sell land to a person who took possession, while the owner retained title.
The statutory definition and its explanation contemplated land being held by different people in different capacities.

The Act provided for possession to revert to the owner when land was surrendered by a person in possession under a part-performance arrangement, together with protections concerning claims against the land.
The Court acknowledged that including the land in multiple holdings could cause prejudice but held that the clear definition had to be applied as written.
issues.conclusion: The same land may form part of the holdings of different persons holding it in different capacities; the possibility of prejudice does not permit a contrary construction of the clear definition.
issues.legal_principle: The explanation to section 3(i) permits the same land to be included in the holdings of persons who hold it in different capacities. Sections 10 and 12(4)–(5) address surrender and provide protections concerning reversion of possession and claims against the land. Where the definition is clear and unambiguous, it must be applied as written rather than altered to avoid possible prejudice; no earlier cases were relied upon.

predicates.ceiling_proceeding: The matter concerned determining land holdings for the purpose of an agricultural land ceiling.
predicates.same_land_held_in_different_capacities: Different people held the same land in distinct capacities, such as owner and person in possession under an agreement for sale.
predicates.definition_clearly_covers_each_capacity: The applicable definition expressly covered the distinct capacities in which the people held the land.

issues.definition: When a ceiling proceeding concerns land held by different people in distinct capacities covered by a clear definition, the land may be included in each person’s holding.
